observed.caption: A long empty paved road lined with trees and utility poles stretches into the distance at an intersection with an ICRAF directional sign.
observed.description: The photo shows a paved intersection in the foreground with a black and white striped curb and low vegetation on a median, a cross street, and a long straight asphalt road with a faded center line receding to the horizon. Green bollards line both sides of the entrance to the long road, with orange traffic cones visible further down the road. Tall wooden utility poles with tangled overhead wires run along the left side of the road, while a row of flat-topped trees with light-colored trunks lines the right side. Behind a fence on the left, tall green crops and a small building are visible, and a white vehicle is partially visible behind the fence. Two people in dark clothing are visible near the roadside, one walking on the far left edge and one standing near the center-left. The sky is overcast with soft diffused daylight.
